versions.subject: Create sysmon_svchost_cred_dump.yml
versions.detection:
selection_process:
    EventID: 10
    destination_process_name: "svchost.exe"
selection_memory:
    EventID: 10
    ProcessAccess: "0x143a"
filter_trusted_process_access:
    source_process_name: 
      - "services.exe"
      - "msiexec.exe"
condition: selection_process and selection_memory and not filter_trusted_process_access
versions.spl: EventID=10 destination_process_name="svchost.exe" EventID=10 ProcessAccess="0x143a" NOT (source_process_name IN ("services.exe", "msiexec.exe"))
